entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, VeloFit agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Got it. I see the order for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered on December 4th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit issue. I've tried everything, adjusted the cleats multiple times, but they just give me terrible blisters on any ride over an hour. They're just not the right shape for my foot.
I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, I've pulled up your order and our policy. It looks like you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window, so I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.

Oh, that's great news. I appreciate that. Now, since I did have a bad experience and will have to go through the trouble of shipping them back, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for a future purchase?

I understand your position. While I'm not authorized to provide discount codes for fit-related returns, what I can do is issue you a pre-paid return shipping label so you won't have to pay to send the shoes back. How does that sound?
A pre-paid label would be very helpful, yes. That works for me. So, just to confirm, you'll email me the label and I'll get the full refund once you receive the cycling shoes back?

That is correct. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with the pre-paid label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once our warehouse logs the return, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for making that easy, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
